description: 행정안전부_사회재난 국민행동요령 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. www. safetydata. go. kr)에서 제공하는 자연재난 발생 시 국민행동 요령 정보로, 화재·붕괴·폭발·교통사고·화생방사고·환경오염사고 등으로 인하여 발생하는 대통령령으로 정하는 규모 이상의 피해와 에너지·통신. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부. Its tags are 국민행동요령, 재난행동요령, 행동요령, 사회재난, 교육. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-04-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
